applicability: Johnson-Nyquist thermal noise voltage floor for a declared resistance, temperature and measurement bandwidth, checked as a physical lower bound against a claimed measured noise floor
assumptions: ideal resistor thermal noise only (no excess/flicker noise from real components)
a flat (unweighted) measurement bandwidth matching the declared value
excluded: active-component (op-amp/ADC) noise beyond the passive thermal floor
uncertainty: Standard textbook physics using the exact SI-defined Boltzmann constant k=1.380649e-23 J/K; hand-verified before use (R=10 kOhm, T=298.15 K, BW=20 kHz -> Vrms=1814.7 nV, matching the commonly cited ~1.8 uV figure).
limits_policy: A claimed noise floor below the computed thermal minimum is flagged as physically inconsistent rather than accepted.
